review_locator: PMCID:PMC7118243, Group 2 Innate Lymphoid Cells in Airway Diseases
primary_title: TNF superfamily member TL1A elicits type 2 innate lymphoid cells at mucosal barriers
decision_basis: The airway-ILC2 review identifies TL1A/DR3 as an ILC2-activating cytokine axis and cites the primary report measuring IL-5 production after recombinant TL1A stimulation of mouse ILC2s.
limitations_preserved: TL1A/DR3-supported IL-5 protein output is measured in mouse lung ILC2 cultures; preserve the receptor/costimulatory and mucosal context, do not infer a universal G-protein or terminal-TF mechanism, and do not transfer to SCI.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC11505104, Regulation of Airway Epithelial-Derived Alarmins in Asthma: Perspectives for Therapeutic Targets
primary_title: TL1A is an epithelial alarmin that cooperates with IL-33 for initiation of allergic airway inflammation
decision_basis: The airway-alarmin review cites the primary study showing IL-33 and TL1A cooperation in inducing a transient IL-9-high ILC2/ILC9 state; the primary measures intracellular IL-9 and secreted IL-9 in ex vivo lung ILC2 cultures.
limitations_preserved: Combined IL-33/TL1A stimulation produces a transient IL-9-high ILC2 state and measured IL-9 protein output; preserve IL-2 preconditioning, transient kinetics, lung ILC2 context and no unmeasured transcription-to-protein step, human equivalence, SCI transfer or terminal-TF inference.
